title: Contract catalog
description: One row of docs/contracts/catalog.md (phase 2 of the contract-first method; template tools/agents/contracts-template.md). Columns, in the template's order: id, version (semver), owner, schema file, example, producer test, consumer test, missing-data behavior, provider (kind:path), model io, swap test, status (active or real). The optional trailing column `frozen` (yes or no) records the freeze: a contract is frozen when its row says yes. `model io`, `status` and `frozen` may be absent as columns. Column names match case-insensitively; extra columns are allowed. The missing-data behavior cell is the declaration of the states of the boundary (ADR-0080 section 3, one vocabulary): `;`-separated `<state>: <behavior> (test: <path>[::name])` items, the state one of available, partial, stale, provider(stub|simulator|fixture|baseline), training, missing, declared once, with `available` and at least one other state; a provider state names its provenance kind and each state names the test that proves it (rules in the sections file). The runtime block an artifact or response carries is C26.

version.description: Semantic version of the contract, for example 1.0.0.

provider.description: kind:path with kind stub, simulator, fixture or baseline.

model io.description: For a model slot: `in: ..., out: ...`; `-` for any other contract.
